raw_text: {"translation": "But those who are harsh and drawn-in and red and [185] dark must be dieted with the moister regimen for the greater part of the time, for such bodies are dry. The distinguishing marks of the temperaments have been written out by me completely in the treatises On Temperaments, in which [it is set out] that the harsh, that is, the hard, and the drawn-in, that is, the lean, are of a drier temperament, as we taught, just as also the dark are. We did not, however, say that the red are dry in temperament, but rather those who approach them in colour, whom they call yellow, since indeed yellow bile too is dry in temperament.
